description: This file defines the ProjectService class in the OrangeHRM Time plugin, providing methods for managing project activities, including validation and conversion to map, relying on data access objects and handling exceptions related to project activities.

classes.name: ProjectService
classes.description: Service class responsible for handling project and project activity operations such as validation and retrieval, utilizing DAOs and throwing specific exceptions.

methods.name: getProjectDao
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the ProjectDao instance used to access project data.

methods.name: getProjectActivityDao
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the ProjectActivityDao instance used for project activity data access.

methods.name: validateProjectActivityName
methods.description: Validates that project activities' names are consistent between source and target projects, checking for non-existent activities and duplicates, and throws exceptions if validation fails.

methods.name: getProjectActivityAsMap
methods.description: Converts a list of ProjectActivity objects into a map keyed by activity name, including id and name in the map entries.
